fullPassage: Take time to be bored. One time I heard a coworker say, "When I get busy, I get stupid." Ain't that the truth. Creative people need time to just sit around and do nothing. I get some of my best ideas when I'm bored, which is why I never take my shirts to the cleaners. I love ironing my shirts — it's so boring, I almost always get good ideas. If you're out of ideas, wash the dishes. Take a really long walk. Stare at a spot on the wall for as long as you can. As the artist Maira Kalman says, "Avoiding work is the way to focus my mind." Take time to mess around. Get lost. Wander. You never know where it's going to lead you.

questions.passage: Take time to be ①<u>bored</u>. One time I ②<u>heard</u> a coworker ③<u>saying</u>, "When I get busy, I get stupid." Creative people ④<u>need</u> time to just sit around and do nothing.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 지각동사 heard + O + 동사원형(say)이 원문. saying은 현재분사 형태로 '진행 중인 말'을 강조할 때 가능하지만, 원문 기준 동사원형 say가 맞음.
det.analysis:
❌ ① bored — 주어(you)가 느끼는 감정이므로 과거분사.
❌ ② heard — hear의 과거형.
✅ ③ saying → say — 지각동사 hear + O + 동사원형(say). 원문 기준 say.
❌ ④ need — Creative people(복수)에 맞는 동사.
det.tip: 지각동사(hear/see/watch) + O + 동사원형(전체 행위) or V-ing(진행 중인 행위)

det.korean: 다림질이 지루함을 유발하는 원인이므로 현재분사 boring이 맞음.
det.analysis:
❌ ① which — 계속적 용법, 앞 절 전체를 받음.
✅ ② bored → boring — it(ironing, 사물)이 주어이므로 '지루하게 만드는' boring. bored는 사람이 느끼는 감정.
❌ ③ ironing — love + V-ing.
❌ ④ good — 형용사.
det.tip: it(사물)이 주어: boring(지루하게 만드는) / I(사람)가 주어: bored(지루해하는)

det.korean: Get + 형용사/과거분사 구문에서 '길을 잃다'는 lost(과거분사)가 맞음.
det.analysis:
❌ ① as — 'as long as'에서 접속사.
❌ ② says — 3인칭 단수.
✅ ③ losing → lost — 'Get lost'는 '길을 잃다'로, get + 과거분사(lost) 구조. losing은 현재분사로 의미가 달라짐.
❌ ④ where — 간접의문문의 의문사.
det.tip: get + 과거분사(형용사): get lost(길을 잃다), get bored(지루해지다), get tired(피곤해지다)
